episodes.title: Scientology's Enforcer Breaks Down On Camera | Louis Theroux's My Scientology Movie
episodes.description: Scientology's top enforcer goes on camera and completely falls apart under his own tactics. Paranoid American and Uncle Sean break down Louis Theroux's 'My Scientology Movie,' exploring how Theroux uses reenactments, a billion-year contract, and the cult's own former enforcer Marty Rathbun to expose the psychological warfare at Scientology's core. From $3 million auditing bills and Tom Cruise recruitment videos to tone-40 ashtray commands and the chilling directive to 'ruin him utterly,' this episode unpacks every hidden treasure and overboard moment the doc has to offer. If you've ever wondered how a sci-fi writer built one of the world's most litigious and secretive organizations, this review is your entry point. **Tags:** My Scientology Movie, Scientology documentary review, Louis Theroux Scientology, Under the Docs, cult documentary, Marty Rathbun, Scientology exposed
